promote.description: Year-end batch promotion — advance every active student in a standard to the next academic year and standard. This only affects one standard at a time; run it once per grade.

setup.title: 1. Choose source and target
setup.description: Pick the standard you're promoting from, the standard students will move into, and the academic year they're moving to.
setup.targetLockedHint: Set automatically to the next standard.
setup.finalHint: Final standard — students graduate to Alumni.

roster.title: 2. Review the roster
roster.description: Active students of the source standard in {{year}} are included by default. Tick a box to change what happens to a specific student.
roster.empty: No active students found in this standard for {{year}}, or they have already been promoted.
roster.help: {{count}} will be promoted, {{holdback}} held back to repeat, {{exclude}} excluded from this batch.
roster.helpFinal: {{count}} will graduate to Alumni, {{holdback}} held back to repeat, {{exclude}} excluded from this batch.

run.title: 3. Preview and confirm
run.description: Always preview first — it runs the same checks without saving anything, so you can catch mistakes before they're permanent.
run.previewSummary: Preview: {{promoted}} would be promoted, {{repeated}} would repeat, {{skipped}} would be skipped.
run.previewSummaryFinal: Preview: {{graduated}} would become Alumni, {{repeated}} would repeat, {{skipped}} would be skipped.

stats.title: Enrollment so far for the target year
stats.description: Fresh joinees vs. promoted/repeated/transferred, per standard.
stats.empty: No enrollments recorded for this year yet.

promote.success: Promotion complete — {{promoted}} promoted, {{repeated}} repeated, {{graduated}} moved to Alumni.

errors.loadFailed: Could not load the students for this promotion
errors.selectAll: Choose the source standard and the target academic year.
errors.standardNotIncremental: Students can only be promoted to the very next standard (e.g. 5th → 6th). Skipping a standard is not allowed.
errors.noTargetStandard: There is no standard after the selected one to promote into.
errors.noPreviousYear: There is no academic year before the selected target year, so there is nobody to promote from.

form.addDescription: Create a student record. Documents and photo can be added after saving.
form.nextAdmissionHelp: Enter manually or use the suggested SJM number. Must be unique within your school.
form.nameEnglishHelp: Optional English/Roman-script name — helps search find the student when the name above is entered in Kannada.
